item.title: Okitsune-sama no Koisuru Omajinai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: chorus
  • 発売日: 2010-06-25
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おキツネ様の恋するおまじない
  • 英語名: Okitsune-sama no Koisuru Omajinai

あらすじ

Yasuto confessed his love to the school idol Kyouka, but not having talked to her at all before, not surprisingly she said no. Broken-hearted, he went to the shrine where he had prayed constantly before the confession and cursed the god, calling them a liar. A darkness surrounds him and a large white fox appears. He apologizes profusely, but she sends tons of snakes after him as retribution. Evading the snakes by climbing a nearby tree, he thought he was safe until he heard a creaking noise. Then, suddenly the tree fell on the shrine, which was demolished. Fleeing to his house, he was surprised to find a miko with beautiful pale hair in front of him, angry that he had destroyed her shrine.
